question: Did offer views drop in the latest 7 days of data compared to the 7 days before that?

golden_sql: SELECT sc.subcategoryname FROM subcategories sc JOIN shop_details s ON sc.id = s.subcategory_id JOIN offer o ON s.id = o.shop_id JOIN shop_address a ON a.shop_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 1 AND a.city = 'Nagercoil' AND a.is_default = 1 GROUP BY sc.id, sc.subcategoryname HAVING AVG(o.offer_price) < 500;

question: Categories and the count of unique cities where their shops operate.
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, COUNT(DISTINCT a.city) AS unique_cities FROM categories c JOIN shop_details s ON c.id = s.category_id JOIN shop_address a ON a.shop_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 1 AND a.is_default = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname;

question: Which categories currently have no active shops?
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname AS category_name FROM categories c LEFT JOIN shop_details s ON s.category_id = c.id AND s.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname HAVING COUNT(s.id) = 0 ORDER BY c.categoriesname;

question: How much revenue did each subscription plan generate from paid invoices?
golden_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.final_amount) AS revenue FROM invoices i JOIN plans p ON p.id = i.plan_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

question: Which category generated the most completed booking revenue? Then: Show the shops in that category, ranked by revenue.
golden_sql: SELECT s.name AS shop_name, SUM(b.final_amount) AS total_revenue FROM bookings b JOIN shop_details s ON s.id = b.shop_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE b.status = 1 AND c.categoriesname = 'Services' GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Which category generated the most completed booking revenue? Then: Show the shops in that category, ranked by revenue.
golden_sql: SELECT s.name AS shop_name, SUM(b.final_amount) AS total_revenue FROM bookings b JOIN shop_details s ON s.id = b.shop_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE b.status = 1 AND c.categoriesname = 'Services' GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Show all active shops.
golden_sql: SELECT s.name AS shop_name FROM shop_details s WHERE s.status = 1;

question: What percentage of reviews created in 2025 were rated five stars?
golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS five_star_percentage FROM reviews WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00';

question: List active shops classified under Snacks & Beverages or Drinks & Beverages.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS shop_name FROM shop_details s JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = s.subcategory_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND sc.subcategoryname IN ('Snacks & Beverages', 'Drinks & Beverages');
